preconditions.text: A FOK order is submitted to the CLOB, the only unfilled amount is lot-size rounding dust, and the user is not charged for that dust.
preconditions.derivation: Conjunction of the prior-state precondition sources: order submission (p_fok_order_submitted), dust-only remainder (p_only_dust_unfilled and as_dust_is_acceptable), and no dust charge (p_user_not_charged_dust).
evidence: Fill-or-Kill (FOK) orders incorrectly revert when any amount remains unfilled, including acceptable dust amounts. According to the protocol's documentation, FOK orders should not revert if only the amount rounded off due to lot size constraints is left unfilled.
> "FOK fill orders *should* not revert if only the amount rounded off is left unfilled, and the user is not charged for the dust."

This breaks core CLOB functionality by making legitimate FOK orders fail unnecessarily. Users cannot execute valid trades when small dust amounts remain unfilled due to lot size constraints, reducing protocol availability and contradicting the intended behavior.
